source: sars-guide:PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Rev 1 p. 32-33 (annual payment worked example, recomputed on the statutory rate table)
notes: Salary R28 000 + bonus R14 800 (3605), under 65, first period. The guide prints tax(336 000) = 49 945 and tax(350 800) = 53 723 (bonus tax 3 778), read off SARS's R500-banded deduction tables (PAYE-GEN-01-G01-A04). On the statutory table: tax(336 000) = 44 118 + 26% x 90 900 - 17 820 = 49 932; tax(350 800) = 53 780; bonus 3 848; salary 49 932 / 12 = 4 161.00; PAYE 8 009.00. This is a known table difference, not a rounding tolerance: only PAYE is asserted, as the guide gives nothing else.
